title: Adaptive Look, Flexible Thought: Learning How and How Long to Think in Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The introduction of long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and external tools has substantially improved the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on general and reasoning tasks. However, existing fast-slow reasoning paradigms mainly regulate textual reasoning length, while visual computation introduced by external tools or visual tokens is often treated as an auxiliary component. This separation prevents MLLMs from jointly optimizing visual perception and textual reasoning. To address this issue, we propose L2T (adaptive Look, flexible Thought), a unified reasoning framework that jointly optimizes the form and depth of computation. translated_title: 自适应观察，灵活思考：在多模态推理中学习如何思考以及思考多久
translated_abstract: 长思维链（CoT）推理和外部工具的引入显著提升了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在通用任务和推理任务上的性能。然而，现有的快慢推理范式主要调节文本推理的长度，而由外部工具或视觉标记引入的视觉计算往往被视为辅助组件。这种分离阻碍了多模态大语言模型对视觉感知和文本推理的联合优化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了L2T（自适应观察，灵活思考），一个联合优化计算形式与深度的统一推理框架。L2T首先将工具产生的视觉状态离散化为视觉标记，使视觉感知与文本推理进入共享的自回归空间。基于这一统一表示，L2T引入了模态感知路由奖励来选择合适的推理模式，以及难度感知（奖励来调节推理深度）……
tldr: 提出L2T统一推理框架，通过将工具产生的视觉状态离散化为视觉标记并引入模态感知路由奖励，联合优化多模态大语言模型的视觉感知形式与推理深度。
en_tdlr: L2T is a unified reasoning framework that jointly optimizes the form and depth of computation in MLLMs by discretizing tool-produced visual states into visual tokens and introducing modality-aware routing rewards.
